description: Fresh EN airport ground-operations admission domain.

units.title: Ground power unit (GPU)
units.text: A ground power unit supplies electrical power to an aircraft while its engines are shut down at the stand. The unit is disconnected before pushback begins.

units.title: Foreign object debris walk
units.text: The ramp team performs a foreign object debris walk before the first departure of each shift. Any loose metal, plastic or stones are removed before equipment enters the stand.

units.title: Wheel chocks
units.text: Wheel chocks are placed only after the aircraft has stopped and the anti-collision beacon is off. The headset operator confirms chocks in place before ground staff approach the doors.

units.title: Pushback clearance
units.text: The flight deck requests pushback clearance from apron control. The tug driver begins movement only after the headset operator repeats the clearance and confirms the towbar area is clear.

units.title: De-icing holdover check
units.text: After anti-icing fluid is applied, the dispatcher records the treatment start time and checks the published holdover table. If the holdover time expires before take-off, the aircraft must be treated again.

units.title: Late baggage reconciliation
units.text: A bag that arrives after loading has closed is not placed on the aircraft automatically. The baggage coordinator verifies the passenger status and instructs the loading team whether the bag may travel.
